title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins race for Alaska governor, replaces a Republican - NPR
description: Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state legislator, ran a campaign emphasizing bipartisanship in the the state that usually votes Republican. At 37, he'll be the youngest governor in the state's history.

title: For weeks, Brooklyn residents felt the shaking. Then came a deadly collapse. - The Washington Post
description: Eight people were killed, prompting investigations and renewed scrutiny of building-code enforcement.

title: Trump to have first trilateral meeting with Putin, Xi - The Washington Post
description: President Donald Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping next week near the end of his Asia trip, the White House said Friday.

title: 'Mormon Wives' Star Taylor Frankie Paul's Ex Dakota Mortensen Sues Hulu for Defamation - TMZ
description: Dakota Mortensen is slamming "Mormon Wives" producers ... claiming they staged scenes and faked storylines to make him appear as a serial cheater and abuser.

title: Setback for SpaceX reusable rocket system despite successful launch - DW.com
description: SpaceX had planned to catch and later reuse both stages of its biggest rocket for the first time. But the booster exploded over the Gulf of Mexico, while the spacecraft continued into orbit.
